subject: Hygiene Development
content: Healthy habits are things you do every day to keep your body strong and well. They include washing hands before eating, brushing teeth twice a day, bathing daily, getting enough sleep, drinking water, and eating fruits and vegetables. Healthy habits prevent sickness and help you grow. Make a routine: wake up, brush teeth, wash face, eat breakfast, go to school. After school: wash hands, eat, play, do homework, bathe, brush teeth, sleep. Small habits every day keep you healthy and ready to learn and play.
summary: Healthy habits: wash hands, brush teeth, bathe, sleep enough, drink water, eat fruits and vegetables. Daily routine keeps you strong.
nigerian_examples: Drinking water from a clean bottle during school break
Eating oranges or bananas as snacks instead of sweets
Going to bed early to wake up fresh for school

quiz_questions.question: Which is a healthy habit?
quiz_questions.explanation: Brushing teeth twice daily prevents cavities and keeps your mouth healthy.

quiz_questions.question: Why is drinking water important?
options: It keeps your body hydrated and healthy
quiz_questions.correct_answer: It keeps your body hydrated and healthy
quiz_questions.explanation: Water helps all your body parts work properly.

quiz_questions.question: How much sleep do children need each night?
quiz_questions.explanation: Children need plenty of sleep to grow, learn, and stay healthy.

quiz_questions.question: What should you eat for a healthy snack?
quiz_questions.explanation: Fruits and vegetables give your body vitamins and energy.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Healthy habits only matter when you are sick.
quiz_questions.explanation: Healthy habits prevent sickness and keep you strong every day.
